skill.name: screenci
skill.description: Create narrated ScreenCI recordings in existing projects by editing `.screenci.ts` scripts, testing flows, and running the ScreenCI workflow.
skill.summary: Build narrated ScreenCI videos from Playwright-style scripts.
skill.author: screenci

security_audit.summary: The review confirmed real risk around automated ScreenCI recording, cloud upload, and handling of SCREENCI_SECRET in local environment files. Most Ruby shell backtick findings are Markdown inline-code false positives, but the documented npm and npx commands are real external command execution. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Automatic screen recording upload can expose sensitive browser content.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before recording, warn that successful recordings upload to ScreenCI, and recommend reviewing pages for private data.

remediation.issue: SCREENCI_SECRET is passed to setup commands and written to screenci/.env.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer secure secret entry, document gitignore expectations, and warn users not to place secrets in shell history or process arguments.

remediation.issue: Anonymous trial recordings upload without an account connection.
remediation.suggestion: Explain the upload destination, access link behavior, and claiming process before running the final record command.

remediation.issue: The workflow runs npm and npx commands from package tooling.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for approval before external package execution and pin versions where the project can support it.

content.value_statement: Teams need clear product videos that match real browser flows. This skill helps create narrated ScreenCI recordings from existing project scripts.
actual_capabilities: Edits or creates `.screenci.ts` recording scripts under `recordings/`.
Uses ScreenCI narration cues, zoom helpers, and hidden setup blocks.
Runs ScreenCI test and record commands through the allowed CLI tools.
Guides optional account setup with `SCREENCI_SECRET` when needed.
Reports the recording URL printed by the ScreenCI CLI.
limitations: Requires an existing ScreenCI project and Node.js 18 or newer.
Recording uploads successful videos to ScreenCI, including anonymous trial uploads.
Does not replace manual review of sensitive pages before recording.
Depends on stable Playwright selectors and accessible page states.

use_cases.title: Create Feature Release Demos
use_cases.description: Record a narrated browser walkthrough that shows a new feature from start to finish.

use_cases.title: Produce Workflow Tutorials
use_cases.description: Turn a real application flow into a tested ScreenCI video with narration and zoom control.

use_cases.title: Document Support Reproductions
use_cases.description: Capture a repeatable support flow as a video that explains each visible step.

prompt_templates.title: Record a Basic Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single product walkthrough.
prompt_templates.prompt: Record a short ScreenCI video for the signup flow. Start on the signup page, narrate the purpose, and show creating a basic account.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing Script
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for improving a current recording.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the existing billing ScreenCI script. Add narration for editing company details, hide setup, test the flow, and record after it passes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Guided Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with zoom and selector expectations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a ScreenCI walkthrough for the admin reporting flow. Use stable selectors, manual zoom for forms, auto zoom for navigation, and report the final URL.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Video Suite
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request across several related recordings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the existing ScreenCI recordings for onboarding. Split long flows, improve narration, handle consent banners in hidden setup, and record only after tests pass.

output_examples.input: Create a video showing users how to update billing details.
output_examples.output: A tested ScreenCI walkthrough with narration cues, hidden setup, form-focused zoom, and the recorded link from ScreenCI.

output_examples.input: Improve a recording script that fails on a cookie banner.
output_examples.output: A revised flow that dismisses the banner during hidden setup, uses stable locator choices, passes testing, and is ready to record.

output_examples.input: Create an onboarding guide video with an optional account secret.
output_examples.output: Clear secret setup guidance, a passing ScreenCI test, and a final recording uploaded to the correct project.

best_practices: Review pages for private data before allowing a recording upload.
Run ScreenCI tests until selectors and narration pass before recording.
Use hidden setup only for authentication, loading, navigation, and consent steps.
anti_patterns: Recording authenticated pages before checking for personal or customer data.
Skipping the test command and uploading the first attempted recording.
Using brittle selectors or forced timing instead of stable Playwright locators.

faq.question: Does this skill initialize new projects?
faq.answer: It is mainly for already initialized ScreenCI projects. It can reference init guidance when setup is needed.

faq.question: Will recordings upload to ScreenCI?
faq.answer: Yes. Successful record commands upload to ScreenCI with or without a SCREENCI_SECRET.

faq.question: Do I need a ScreenCI account?
faq.answer: No. Anonymous trial uploads are supported, while SCREENCI_SECRET connects recordings to an organization.

faq.question: What files does it edit?
faq.answer: It works with recording scripts, ScreenCI config files, and screenci/.env when the user provides a secret.

faq.question: Can it use authenticated pages?
faq.answer: Yes, but users should review sensitive content first. Authentication and setup can be hidden from the final video.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
